notes.subject: Kristy call notes / relationship history
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten 2026 sheet lists Three Forks Rodeo and notes a June 2 call, a fax/bad-number issue, and contacting the chamber. Gmail shows much stronger prior interest: Christina Kamps requested details in 2023, and in 2024 Chamber president Leann Bryant wanted the pay-for-play option but Adventure Zone was unavailable for their dates. Source: handwritten call notes page 84; Adventure Zone Gmail.

followUps.label: 2027 booking follow-up
followUps.reason: The event/chamber previously showed real interest in the pay-for-play option, but Adventure Zone was unavailable for the requested 2024 dates. Reconnect early for 2027.
